exports.sonioxTtsAdapter: default TTS adapter instance; synthesize(text, model, credentials, responseFormat, options)
exports.sonioxSttAdapter: default STT adapter instance; transcribe({ model, formData, credentials, kind, signal })
exports.createSonioxTtsAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, timeoutMs, maxAudioBytes } for tests
exports.createSonioxSttAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, totalTimeoutMs, callTimeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, maxTranscriptBytes, wait, now } for tests
exports.buildSonioxSpeechRequest: (model, text, options) -> source speech body { text, model, language, voice, audio_format }; throws status 400
exports.buildSonioxTranscriptionRequest: async (model, formData, { kind }) -> { upload: FormData, job, responseFormat, verbose, wantWords } or a 400 error result with local: true
exports.sonioxJobBody: (job, fileId) -> source job body in source key order
exports.sonioxTranscriptBody: (transcript, { verbose, wantWords }) -> { body, audioSeconds } or null
exports.resolveSonioxVoice: source resolveSonioxVoice (OpenAI stock voice or empty -> Adrian)
exports.matchesSonioxContainer: (container, bytes) leading-byte check for mp3, wav, opus (Ogg)
exports.sonioxAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState, jobId) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.SONIOX_PROVIDER_DEFINITION: staged registry entry (id, alias, aliases, display, apikey auth, transport.validateUrl, serviceKinds, ttsConfig, sttConfig)

models.voiceSuffix: tts model/voice accepted; default voice Adrian; OpenAI stock voices map to Adrian
models.dynamicDiscovery: none: the pinned source lists Soniox audio models statically and has no Soniox models fetcher; the only Soniox list call is the validation probe GET /v1/transcriptions

speech.answer: audio bytes in the requested container

createTranscription.body: { model, file_id, enable_language_identification: true, enable_speaker_diarization?, context?, language_hints? }

transcript.answer: { text?, tokens?: [{ text, start_ms, end_ms, speaker?, language? }] }

bounds.retries: 0 for upload, create and speech; status checks repeat only inside the deadline
